point_in_time_decision_rules.RULE_1: IF publication_timestamp_ist <= 08:30:00 IST of prediction date D -> ELIGIBLE_FOR_INFERENCE
point_in_time_decision_rules.RULE_2: IF publication_timestamp_ist > 08:30:00 IST of prediction date D -> BLOCKED_FUTURE_INFORMATION
point_in_time_decision_rules.RULE_3: IF publication_timestamp_ist IS NULL OR UNVERIFIABLE -> MARK_UNUSABLE_REJECT
